name: RTS Extension Template
description: Template for building The Road to Somewhere Streamer.bot extensions.

website.footerLabel: Part of The Road to Somewhere.

experience.title: A consistent foundation for RTS extensions.
experience.text: Use this repository as the starting point for a new The Road to Somewhere Streamer.bot extension.

features.title: Data driven
features.text: Keep extension-specific content in rts.json rather than hard-coding it into the website template.

features.title: Release ready
features.text: The publishing workflow handles versioned release assets and the published import-code filename.

features.title: Shared UI
features.text: Supported extensions can use the shared RtsUI.dll settings experience.

features.title: Optional overlay
features.text: Add an overlay directory and release asset when the extension needs an OBS browser source.

setup.title: Build the extension.
setup.intro: Replace the template content with your extension implementation and keep the repository structure intact.

steps.title: Define the extension
steps.description: Update site/rts.json with the extension name, content, setup instructions, dependencies and release policy.

steps.title: Add the import code
steps.description: Export the required Streamer.bot actions and replace the contents of RTS Extension - Import Code.txt. Keep the filename unchanged.

steps.title: Add optional assets
steps.description: Place extension-owned images and video under assets/. Add an overlay/ directory when the extension provides an OBS overlay.

steps.title: Create the release
steps.description: Create a version tag and GitHub release. The workflow uses the release version when publishing the extension files.

notes: Do not rename RTS Extension - Import Code.txt in the source repository. The release build publishes it automatically as Extension Name vX.Y.Z - Import Code.txt.
Keep extension-specific website content in site/rts.json. Do not edit generated website files.
